positions.title: Technology Associate
positions.description:
- Designed and developed a new application to reconcile software licensing consumption for IBM, resulting in a more efficient and accurate tracking system.
- Utilized React and Python to create a web application and API, respectively, improving user experience and streamlining data management processes.
- Collaborated with team members to identify opportunities for process improvement and implemented solutions that eliminated manual processes, standardized procedures, and reduced reliance on tribal 
knowledge.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Designed and developed new features using React, Redux, and JavaScript, resulting in a more efficient and user-friendly interface.
- Implemented automatic form translation based on user region, improving the application's accessibility
- Conducted product demos for key stakeholders, incorporating their feedback to refine features and ensure alignment with user needs.

positions.title: 2020 Hack.Diversity Fellow
positions.description:
- Secured a highly competitive position in the 2020 Hack.Diversity Fellowship, a leading career leadership and workforce development program that brings together Boston's innovation, corporate, civic, academic, and philanthropic sectors.
- Participated in a series of innovative workshops, seminars, team projects, and professional development exercises, developing valuable skills in leadership, communication, and teamwork.
